summary_reason: Collocation index 2 contains an unnatural predicate-noun mismatch ('契約書を解除する' instead of '契約を解除する' or '契約書を作成する'), and Vietnamese example translations suffer from templated slash-concatenation.

collocations.text: 業務委託契約書を締結する
collocations.reason: Standard, highly authentic business and legal phrasing.

collocations.text: 業務委託契約書を更新する
collocations.reason: Commonly used in corporate administration when renewing term agreements on file, though '契約を更新する' or '契約書を作成・改定する' is slightly more precise legally.

collocations.text: 業務委託契約書を解除する
collocations.reason: Semantic incompatibility between the tangible document ('契約書') and the legal status predicate ('解除する'). In Japanese civil law and corporate practice, one terminates/cancels the legal relationship itself ('業務委託契約を解除する') or revokes/shreds the document ('契約書を破棄する').
collocations.suggested_text: 業務委託契約書を作成する

collocations.text: 業務委託契約書の条項を確認する
collocations.reason: Standard legal/business collocation used during contract review.

examples.reason: Authentic Japanese corporate phrasing commonly heard in transaction negotiations.
Flawless enterprise wording reflecting internal compliance and risk review workflow.

dialogue.reason: Highly realistic conversational flow between enterprise professionals discussing contract negotiation and legal turnaround.

translations.reason: In the example translations, the Vietnamese rendered the term with raw dictionary slashes ('hợp đồng thuê khoán ngoài / dịch vụ ủy thác'), which sounds unpolished. In corporate contexts, 'hợp đồng dịch vụ' or 'hợp đồng thuê ngoài' should be selected naturally without slashes.
